question: What is the Southern Appalachian Fly Fishing Hall of Fame?
answer: The Southern Appalachian Fly Fishing Hall of Fame honors individuals who have made significant contributions to fly fishing in the Southern Appalachian region. Mac Brown was inducted in 2017 in the Recreation category, recognized for nearly three decades of fly fishing education, guide training, conservation work, and contributions to the sport through instruction and research in Bryson City, North Carolina.

question: Why was Mac Brown inducted into the Fly Fishing Hall of Fame?
answer: Mac Brown was inducted for his contributions to fly fishing and fly casting education globally — through 30+ years of professional instruction in Bryson City, NC, university research at Western Carolina University, the publication of Casting Angles, training of competitive Team USA anglers, and development of the Fly Fishing Guide School as the premier guide training program in the eastern United States.

question: What is Mac Brown's book Casting Angles?
answer: Casting Angles is a fly casting handbook written by Mac Brown — the only FFI Master Casting Instructor in North Carolina. Endorsed by the ACA, FFI, and recognized instructors as a reference for fly casting mechanics, it presents a mechanics-based approach to understanding and improving the fly cast. Available signed directly from Mac Brown for $34.95 plus shipping.

question: How long has Mac Brown been guiding in Bryson City NC?
answer: Mac Brown has been guiding and teaching fly fishing in Bryson City, North Carolina since 1987 — founding the first full-time fly fishing guide service in Western NC. Over 38 years of daily on-water experience across thousands of guided trips and school sessions.

question: What awards has Mac Brown received for fly fishing?
answer: Mac Brown has received the FFI Lifetime Achievement Award (2023), the FFI Mel Krieger Casting Instructor Award (2021), Field & Stream Angler of the Year (1999), Southern Appalachian Fly Fishing Hall of Fame inductee (2017), and multiple Fly Fishers United Best Guide School awards. He serves as Director of Teacher Development for FFI Casting Instructor Education and Associate Editor of The Loop Journal.
